title: Some complete $\omega$-powers of a one-counter language in the difference hierarchy
abstract: arXiv:2610.16473v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fix a finite alphabet $\Sigma$ having at least two letters, and natural numbers $n,k\geq 1$. We denote by $D_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ the class of differences of $n$ subsets of the Cantor space $\Sigma^\omega$ in $\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k$, and by $D^-_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ the class of complements of sets in $D_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$. We prove, for any natural numbers $n,k\geq 1$, the existence of a finite alphabet $\Sigma$ having at least two letters and a finitary language $U_{n,k}$ over $\Sigma$ accepted by a one-counter automaton such that the $\omega$-power $$U_{n,k}^\infty:=\{ w_0w_1\cdots\in\Sigma^\omega\mid\forall i\in\omega ~~w_i\in U_{n,k}\}$$ is $D_{2n-1}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$-complete. translated_title: 差分层次中单计数器语言的若干完备 $\omega$-幂
translated_abstract: 固定一个至少含有两个字母的有限字母表 $\Sigma$，以及自然数 $n,k\geq 1$。我们用 $D_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ 表示康托空间 $\Sigma^\omega$ 中属于 $\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k$ 类的 $n$ 个子集之差的类，并用 $D^-_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ 表示 $D_n(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ 中集合的补集所构成的类。我们证明，对于任意自然数 $n,k\geq 1$，存在一个至少含有两个字母的有限字母表 $\Sigma$ 以及 $\Sigma$ 上一个被单计数器自动机接受的有限语言 $U_{n,k}$，使得其 $\omega$-幂 $$U_{n,k}^\infty:=\{ w_0w_1\cdots\in\Sigma^\omega\mid\forall i\in\omega ~~w_i\in U_{n,k}\}$$ 是 $D_{2n-1}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$-完备的。我们还证明了对偶类 $D^-_{2n}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ 的一个条件性结果：在假设存在一个被单计数器自动机接受的有限语言 $V_{n,3}$、且其 $\omega$-幂 $V_{n,3}^\infty$ 是 $D^-_{2n}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_3)$-完备的前提下（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文证明了对于任意自然数 $n,k\geq 1$，存在被单计数器自动机接受的有限语言，其 $\omega$-幂在差分层次中是 $D_{2n-1}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$-完备的，并给出了对偶类 $D^-_{2n}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$ 的条件性结果。
en_tdlr: For any $n,k\geq 1$, there exists a finitary language accepted by a one-counter automaton whose $\omega$-power is $D_{2n-1}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$-complete in the difference hierarchy, together with a conditional result for the dual classes $D^-_{2n}(\mathbf{\Pi}^0_k)$.
